one_liner: Grain is an AI meeting memory platform that records or ingests calls, generates notes/action items, and exposes meeting data via a public API and an official MCP server.
access_notes: Personal Access Tokens are available on all plans; OAuth public clients can self‑register via client metadata; Workspace Access Tokens and OAuth workspace scope require Business/Enterprise and Grain verification.
blocker_notes: OAuth workspace scope only for verified clients; Workspace tokens only on paid plans (Business/Enterprise).

evidence.quote: Public clients, such as MCP clients and native apps, can skip Step 1 by using an HTTPS URL as their `client_id`. That URL must serve a JSON Client ID Metadata Document…
Workspace API access is available on Business and Enterprise plans and requires admin access to generate.
Is there a sandbox environment for testing? No sandbox is available at this time.
Hooks let Grain notify your server when something happens.
Grain's official MCP server is available now for all users!
